title: Creative catalogue: four representation approaches
status_note: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

records.construction: Use original articulated line characters, crisp props and explicit highlights. Keep one causal relationship legible at a time.
records.communicative_difference: Emphasizes symbolic relationships, exact matching and readable cause/effect without depth distractions.
records.gate: Rig contacts, text layout and every diagram relationship must be checked; this is 2D animation.

records.construction: Stage the same action as a drawn field-note sequence. Add traces, section views and short observations in the order they are needed.
records.communicative_difference: Makes reasoning and uncertainty visible through progressive construction, rather than presenting only the final state.
records.gate: Verify stroke order, annotation tracking and model limits. Rough strokes must never change factual geometry.

records.construction: Build the scene with original volumetric props and grounded characters, then use lighting, contact and a restrained camera to show the same conflict.
records.communicative_difference: Emphasizes embodied effort, occlusion and spatial consequences that the diagrammatic view abstracts.
records.gate: Requires a real 3D scene, alternate-angle check, contact/shadow review and source reopening. Blockbench is a research-only asset option.

records.construction: Create original foreground, character, prop and background planes with meaningful depth order. Use gentle parallax, grounded articulation and explicit masks to stage the existing story.
records.communicative_difference: Emphasizes layered attention, a rich setting and a gradual foreground/background discovery while retaining the readability of illustration.
records.gate: This is 2.5D, not true volumetric 3D. Check masks, disocclusion gaps, foot anchors, occlusion order, scene-space transforms and every texture license.
